FAIL_TO_PASS: function-arguments: removes unneeded arguments from calls to functions
arrow-function-arguments: removes unneeded arguments from calls to arrow functions
patterns: removes unneeded arguments from calls when patterns are used
unused-parameters: removes arguments that correspond to unused parameters
namespace-members: removes unneeded arguments across namespace member calls
expression-cache: should update cache of logical and conditional expressions
import-function: set parameters to literal if all calls are literal
